segments.source: centeredHorizontally

segments.source: **Framework**: AppKit **Kind**: property
segments.ko: **Framework**: AppKit **Kind**: property

segments.source: Scroll so that the selected items’ bounding box is centered horizontally in the collection view’s bounds.
segments.ko: 선택한 항목의 경계 상자가 컬렉션 뷰 경계 내에서 수평으로 가운데 오도록 스크롤합니다.

segments.source: This option must not be combined with the [`left`](nscollectionview/scrollposition/left.md), [`right`](nscollectionview/scrollposition/right.md), [`leadingEdge`](nscollectionview/scrollposition/leadingedge.md), [`trailingEdge`](nscollectionview/scrollposition/trailingedge.md), or [`nearestVerticalEdge`](nscollectionview/scrollposition/nearestverticaledge.md) options, but may be combined with other options.
segments.ko: 이 옵션은 [`left`](nscollectionview/scrollposition/left.md), [`right`](nscollectionview/scrollposition/right.md), [`leadingEdge`](nscollectionview/scrollposition/leadingedge.md), [`trailingEdge`](nscollectionview/scrollposition/trailingedge.md), [`nearestVerticalEdge`](nscollectionview/scrollposition/nearestverticaledge.md) 옵션과 함께 사용할 수 없지만, 다른 옵션과는 결합할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: **Availability**:
segments.ko: **Availability**:

segments.source: macOS ?+
